topics.title: Challenge cardinality
topics.reason: The North Star intentionally uses neutral Challenge(s) wording and does not decide whether one Journey has exactly one Challenge or may have multiple Challenges.
topics.notes: PD-014 supports multiple Journey-specific undertakings; आव्हान is optional, not exactly one mandatory Challenge. Detailed lifecycle/completion semantics remain DT-007 and DT-015.

topics.title: Feature-level Vratamitra information, actions, and permissions
topics.reason: Do not globally enumerate exact visibility, actions, contributions, validation, chat or reference behavior, and permissions before the relevant features are designed. Derive information, access, ownership, Primary versus Journey Vratamitra scope, and historical behavior as each feature is modeled.
topics.notes: Cross-cutting: revisit for chat, Journey evidence, Exposures, Resolutions, Challenges, reassessment, resources, AI summaries, and other feature-design phases. Include exact post-relationship access to feature-specific artifacts after their ownership/participation models and permissions are designed; former-Primary status alone does not grant continuing broad Primary-level access. Do not invent access categories here. Reconcile completed-Journey visibility and post-relationship access for former Journey Vratamitras under PH-008 and PH-011; Journey completion does not itself determine that access. PD-014 confirms Journey Vratamitra custom suggestions and Vratarthi final authority; exact contribution actions and visibility remain for feature-level permissions. References to possible features here do not approve new ontology entities.

topics.title: Community moderation actions and escalation
topics.reason: PD-011 confirms Moderator purpose at the actor level; exact moderation scopes, visibility rules, actions, reports, restrictions, removal, and escalation remain deferred until community features and content types are modeled, with permission reconciliation in PH-008.
topics.notes: Include moderation of user-generated/community content for different visibility contexts, and exact scopes, visibility rules, actions, and permissions; reconcile permission implications in PH-008. Current actor purpose is preserved in PD-011.

topics.title: Resource structure, relationships, curation, and promotion
topics.reason: Curators steward centrally curated or endorsed resources, while approval, promotion, featuring, pinning, official status, recommendations, collections, and entity-linking mechanics should be decided per content type.
topics.notes: PH-005 owns Resource classification/internal structure, Pothi/श्लोक/section modeling, potential developmental-concept relationships, and creation/publishing/curation/promotion mechanisms. Also decide whether/how Journey-specific custom suggestions enter shared catalogs; no automatic promotion is established. Reconcile user-authored content entering curated Resources with PH-006 (DT-017) and publishing/access permissions with PH-008. Handbook/Pothi Resource status and format-neutral boundaries are confirmed by PD-015; shared curated developmental catalogs by PD-013.

topics.title: Authentication methods, account-linking, and return-to-context UX
topics.reason: Public visitors may encounter actions that require registration or login; preserve the attempted context and design the return behavior when authentication journeys are specified.
topics.notes: Supported authentication providers, account-linking flows, login/signup screens, and authentication-return behavior remain undecided. Multiple methods authenticate the same persistent account/Vratarthi identity under PD-011. Implementation and token/session architecture remain outside this ontology cluster and belong to later implementation work.

topics.title: Under-18 public access and age-gating details
topics.reason: Sign-up is restricted to age 18+, but public browsing, age declaration or verification, rationale and communication, and related access behavior remain undecided.
topics.notes: Also reconcile age-gated public journeys and edge cases in PH-011.

topics.title: Challenge application semantics
topics.reason: Challenge(s) contribute to application and evidence of developmental change; lifecycle, repeatability, success and completion semantics, authoring or selection, and relationship to Journey completion remain undecided.
topics.notes: PD-014 now defines आव्हान and optional/multiple undertaking support; DT-001 is resolved. Keep detailed Challenge lifecycle, iteration, completion, exceptions, and participation workflows open, coordinated with DT-015. Do not restore historical thresholds or assume every Journey requires a Challenge.

topics.title: Notification and re-engagement model
topics.reason: The notification constraint in PD-006 is confirmed; the notification and re-engagement model and its mechanics are intentionally left for later design.
topics.notes: Later decisions include notification-producing events; recipients; urgency and importance; in-app notification center/activity model; reminders and re-engagement; email, push, and in-app channels; timing; batching and deduplication; read, unread, and actioned state; preferences and controls; notification-to-action navigation; ignored or expired notifications; and anti-dependency/anti-nagging behavior. Reconcile the experience in PH-011; carry relevant implications into PH-013 through PH-016. Do not decide these mechanics in this record.

topics.title: Automatic Vratamitra invitation expiry
topics.reason: The confirmed Primary Vratamitra lifecycle leaves automatic invitation expiry undecided; it establishes acceptance, withdrawal, and decline states but no automatic expiry rule.

moves.reason: PH-002 has established acceptance, withdrawal, decline, replacement, terminal states, and Journey-completion closure. Automatic time-based expiry and its duration are not required to complete the actor/relationship model; PH-011 can decide this later journey/state/UX policy with actual invitation flows and the notification/re-engagement model available.

topics.notes: Also covers automatic expiry and expiry timing for specific-person Journey Vratamitra invitations. Closing a pending Journey invitation on Journey completion is confirmed in PD-008 and is distinct from an undecided time-based expiry rule.

topics.title: Canonical identity/account ontology
topics.reason: PH-002 confirms participation and capability roles without establishing account or database entity structure. PH-003 must define the relationship between person, signed-in user/account, Vratarthi, profile, roles/capabilities, and relationship assignments while preserving that every signed-in user is a Vratarthi.
topics.notes: Resolved by PD-011: Account, persistent Vratarthi identity, automatic Profile, authentication state/methods, granted capabilities, contextual roles, and relationship assignments are conceptually distinguished; no separate Person entity is currently needed. Profile details, account exit, and UX/permission mechanics remain separately deferred.

topics.title: Invitation flows and guidance mode-switch UX edge cases
topics.reason: PH-002 establishes domain invitation and guidance semantics, while exact invitation flows, changing pending invitees, confirmation dialogs, and mode-switch UX edge cases require later user-journey design.
topics.notes: Reconcile pending replacement invitations when another explicit mode change occurs and the actual invitation/solo-to-guidance flows. Preserve accepted domain rules; time-based expiry remains DT-009 and notification mechanics remain DT-008. Include general Veervrat invitations and guidance invitations to registered or unregistered recipients: link/token structure, delivery, matching, routing, recipient choices, registration followed by explicit relationship acceptance, and pending invitation UX. Do not infer a Person entity or change accepted lifecycle semantics.

topics.title: Platform-capability grants, revocation, and Admin authority
topics.reason: PD-011 establishes Curator, Moderator, and Admin as granted platform capabilities, while exact granting authority, permission scopes, revocation, and operational mechanics remain deferred to permissions/privacy design.
topics.notes: Extend the existing Admin authority question to exact granting authority, permission scopes, revocation, and operational mechanics for explicitly granted Curator, Moderator, and Admin capabilities. Vratamitra requires no separate platform-role grant under PD-011; contextual roles do not inherently grant unrestricted permissions.

topics.title: Account exit and lifecycle policy
topics.reason: Account deactivation and deletion are legitimate concepts to consider, but their behavior is not established by the identity ontology cluster.
topics.notes: Decide deactivation, permanent deletion, identity termination, data retention, historical Vratamitra relationship implications, contributions/content after exit, and account-management UX. No exit semantics are established yet.

topics.title: Profile details, visibility, editing, and presentation
topics.reason: PD-011 establishes an automatic Profile distinct from account identity, including before optional details are supplied; actual fields, public visibility, editing permissions, and Profile UI are not decided.

moves.reason: PD-015 captures the conceptual boundary: Profile information is separate from Vratarthi-owned Journeys and assessments. Remaining Profile fields and experience belong to PH-009, permissions/visibility/editing to PH-008, and user journeys to PH-011; no additional Profile fields or behavior are required to finish this ontology cluster.

topics.notes: Keep remaining Profile fields, visibility, editing, and presentation open. A later Profile page may display developmental records without owning them. Completion remains unnecessary for participation under PD-011. Original deferral reason is retained; PD-015 addresses conceptual ownership without deciding fields, persistence, or page behavior.

topics.title: Journey, अनुभव, and संकल्प lifecycle and participation workflows
topics.reason: PD-014 confirms conceptual Journey and undertaking structure, but detailed lifecycle, completion, iteration, recurrence, exceptions, and participation workflows require PH-004 design.
topics.notes: Explicitly decide संकल्प completion, reiteration and refinement; ongoing Journey choice/automatic reuse when another उणीव reaches the same विधान; अनुभव/संकल्प workflows; and Journey completion mechanics. Coordinate आव्हान workflows with DT-007 and contribution permissions with DT-002. Preserve completed-संकल्प minimum and optional अनुभव/आव्हान without importing historical states, thresholds, or durations.

topics.title: Self-assessment scales, scoring, and interaction mechanics
topics.reason: PD-013 confirms assessment meaning and statement selection, but not rating scales, scoring, presentation, or interactions.
topics.notes: Separate assessment from proof of success. Do not inherit historical answer labels, filtering, aggregation, recommendation thresholds, or an independent assessment-definition catalog.

topics.title: User-authored content and community participation concepts
topics.reason: PD-015 distinguishes authored content from curated Resources without approving Posts, Blogs, feeds, or other community-content mechanisms.
topics.notes: Decide whether such mechanisms exist and their content/participation rules. Coordinate possible authored-content entry into curated Resources with DT-004, moderation with DT-003, and access/publishing permissions with PH-008. Historical Daily Logs and experience posts are not approved redesign features.

topics.title: Broader Veervrat progression, milestones, and readiness
topics.reason: Whether multiple Journeys and aggregate completed अनुभव, संकल्प, and आव्हाने contribute to a broader milestone or readiness to formally undertake Veervrat remains undecided.
topics.notes: PH-004 owns later progression design and may carry this forward with explicit history. No numerical milestones from brainstorming or historical literature are approved requirements; do not conflate Journey completion with the संस्कार or developmental success.

topics.title: Final name for गुणदर्शक विधान / Virtue Expression
topics.reason: PD-013 confirms the concept and bilingual definition but both names remain provisional.
topics.notes: Finalize product-language naming without reopening the agreed concept or making personal statements/catalogs an approved feature.
